headline: UCCS go clear of Fort Lewis in goals scored
dek: UCCS's win over Lubbock Christian and Fort Lewis's draw at Fort Hays State split the two on Sunday, and UCCS now lead the scoring on fourteen goals. Both remain unbeaten, and only CSU Pueblo have won every match they have played.
displaced_by: UCCS beat Lubbock Christian while Fort Lewis drew at Fort Hays State; the scoring lead is no longer shared

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The gap between the top and the bottom of the chart is still wide: Colorado Mesa, Colorado School of Mines, Regis and Adams State have scored fewer goals together than UCCS have alone.

wire.line: Adams State have lost all three of their matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fort Lewis's draw at Fort Hays State was the first match this season they have failed to win; they have three wins and have not lost.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but nine have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hugo Sjöberg's seventeen saves for UCCS have come at the cost of two goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Regis's draw at Cal State San Bernardino leaves them with one goal scored and one conceded across a win, a draw and a defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado Mesa have drawn three matches and lost one, and are still without a win.

last_match.line: UCCS remain unbeaten; Lubbock Christian have now lost to Fort Lewis, MSU Denver and UCCS and beaten only Adams State.

next_match.line: UCCS have yet to lose and have scored in every match; Hawaii Hilo also visit CSU Pueblo and MSU Denver later in the month.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
